ENGRAM SPAWN PRACTICE from 2026-11-17 22:05Z (Greg via Asistant #1515: switch Sol 6.1 to Sol 6.2 now, with no restart). Every new Engram Codex spawn (reviewers, explorers, coders, workers) passes model "gpt-6.2-sol" in termal_spawn_session's `model` field. Existing root sessions can't be switched through agent tools; switch them through TermAl's own setting or a fresh session. Source: rules-greg-codex-sol62-switch-2026-11-17.
GREG 2026-11-26 about 17:30Z, via Asistant 43498a6e #2108, on coding sessions (including Windows B), verbatim: „Wazne aby modele byly dobrze ustawione Opus Sol6.2 reasoning effor high.” Coding sessions use Claude Opus or Codex gpt-6.2-sol, reasoning effort high. Before assigning work to a new session, confirm its EFFECTIVE settings (agent, model, reasoning effort) from the host's session record; don't rely on the request alone. Never change global or default configuration to get there; Greg owns that (he fixed TermAl's default models on 2026-11-26).
Revise this entry if the id or TermAl's default changes.
